title: LXD Snap 5.21 LTS bundles outdated OVMF (2022) lacking UEFI CA 2023
description:
### Please confirm

- [x] I have searched existing issues to check if an issue already exists for the bug I encountered.

### Distribution

Ubuntu 24.04

### Distribution version

snap : lxd     5.21.4-aee7e08  38767  5.21/stable    canonical✓  -

### System info

Note that dmidecode inside guests reports 2/2/2022, preventing fwupdmgr from performing critical Secure Boot CA rotations.

```
mastier@rezolutny:~$ sudo dmidecode -s bios-version
sudo dmidecode -s bios-release-date
unknown
2/2/2022
```

Also check the snaps OVMF seems to confirm it
```
$ sudo strings /snap/lxd/current/share/qemu/OVMF_VARS.4MB.ms.fd | grep -iE "CA" | head -n 20

### Expected behavior

I run the update, but of course it fails

failed to write-firmware: failed to write DBUpdate3P2023.bin: failed to write data to efivarsfs: Error writing to file descriptor: Permission denied
```

### Actual behavior

The CA is up-to-date

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run any Ubuntu 26.04 vm
2. check `sudo dmidecode -s bios-release-date`
3. check `sudo fwupdmgr get-updates; sudo fwupdmgr upgrade` , the latter should show no updates

### Information to attach

- [ ] Any relevant kernel output (`dmesg`)
- [ ] Instance configuration (`lxc config show <instance> --expanded`)
- [ ] Main daemon log (at `/var/log/lxd/lxd.log` or `/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/logs/lxd.log`)
- [ ] If a lxc command fails, output of the command with `--debug`
- [ ] Output of the daemon with `--debug` (or use `lxc monitor` while reproducing the issue)
author: mastier

comments.author: tomponline
comments.body:
Thanks, this is a known issue see above.

Currently we are working with the Ubuntu Engineering team to ensure that the necessary fixes are backported to the relevant Ubuntu versions so that the LXD snap can make use of them.

Additionally due to historical reasons LXD 5.21 is not yet on core24 and so we will need to complete that migration in order to benefit from the updated OVMF package.

comments.author: tomponline
comments.body: In the mean time LXD 6/candidate should contain an updated OVMF package, please can you confirm that the issue is resolved there? Thanks
